implementation_summary: Fixes the three blocking data-preservation defects found by code review (CR-005, CR-006, CR-007). CR-005 (src/codemie/core/a2ui/legacy_converter.py): every component id now goes through a new _IdAllocator, which reserves the ids the legacy surface itself uses and hands out unique ones deterministically by appending '-2', '-3', ... A synthesized id ('root', '<button>-label', '<parent>-c<i>') yields to a real element that already claims that name; a real id repeated by the legacy surface keeps the name on its first occurrence only. Because the root Column's id can therefore be renamed, reverse_request no longer looks the root up by the literal ROOT_ID: the new _root_component() finds it structurally as the first component no other component references via 'children'/'child' (ROOT_ID stays as the fallback), which restores reversibility for the previously broken rows. convert_message now runs its own output through codemie.core.a2ui.catalog.validate_envelopes and raises the new ConversionError when the envelopes do not validate, so an unrenderable surface is never persisted; convert_history's existing except-branch turns that into stats['failed'] and leaves the message byte-identical. convert_history(history, context=...) and convert_message(..., context=...) take an optional context (the conversation id) and the warning log now reads 'A2UI history conversion failed for conversation <id> message <index>: ...' instead of the bare error text, so the rows behind a failed count can be found. Migration f1a2b3c4d5e6 passes the conversation id into the rewrite callback accordingly. Module docstring: loss registry gained item 9 (duplicate legacy ids are de-collided), item 8 clarified, and a note that invalid output is never persisted. CR-006 (src/external/alembic/versions/d1c2b3a4e5f6_drop_interactive_features_from_assistants.py): downgrade() re-adds the JSONB column and then backfills it from the boolean that revision e7f8a9b0c1d2 is about to drop -- UPDATE assistants SET interactive_features = '{"action_buttons": true, "choice": true, "short_forms": true}'::jsonb WHERE interactive_enabled = true -- which is exactly the object the old single-switch UI wrote; assistants with the toggle off keep the NULL add_column leaves. Docstring rewritten to match. CR-007 (src/codemie/rest_api/models/conversation.py): GeneratedMessage re-declares interactive_request/interactive_response as Optional[dict] pass-through fields (opaque dicts -- the legacy pydantic models are deleted) with a comment marking them DEPRECATED, explaining that PydanticListType re-dumps the whole history on every write so omitting them would erase the legacy payload on the first new turn and make the history migration irreversible, and stating they must be deleted once the rollback window closes. Nothing reads them: to_chat_history and the chat pipeline stay on the A2UI branch. No migration was applied to any database.
